# alta_devices (Data Source)

The hardware a site has adopted.

A device is identified by its MAC address, which is not something anyone should have to look up in the portal and paste into a configuration. Use this to find it: `data.alta_devices.routers.devices[0].id`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A device is identified by its MAC address. Find it rather than pasting it.
data "alta_devices" "routers" {
  kind = "router"
}

# Most configuration belongs to the site, so it needs no device at all. The ones that
# configure the hardware itself can take the id from here, or from the provider block.
resource "alta_switch_port" "uplink" {
  device_id = data.alta_devices.routers.devices[0].id

  port         = 5
  native_vlan  = 2
  tagged_vlans = [2, 30]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `kind` (String) Return only devices of this kind: `router`, `switch`, `ap`, `filter` or `controller`.
- `site_id` (String) Alta site. Defaults to the provider's `site_id`.

### Read-Only

- `devices` (Attributes List) Matching devices, ordered by id so the list is stable. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--devices))

<a id="nestedatt--devices"></a>
### Nested Schema for `devices`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) MAC address, lowercase without separators.
- `kind` (String) `router`, `switch`, `ap`, `filter` or `controller`.
- `model` (String) Model, as the cloud reports it.
- `name` (String) Name shown in the portal.
- `version` (String) Firmware version.
